hook: One lost move. One new habit.
text: One lost move. One new habit. After a blitz loss, replay one decision. Name the threat, test your move against their forcing reply, and write one cue for next time. In our constructed position, 1...Rxd2? grabbed a pawn but allowed 2.Ra8+ Rd8 3.Rxd8#. The useful note: check the back rank before moving its only defender. Try a five-minute review, then practise in the Academy.
